name: – Niclas Herbst – After § 10 – Am 4
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 10 a. Calls on the Commission to present a legislative framework aimed at countering the excessive concentration of wealth and economic power among ultra-high-net-worth individuals, through measures enhancing financial transparency, equitable taxation and market competition, in order to prevent systemic risks to democratic governance, social cohesion and the integrity of the internal market;
